about: Evaluation set of the chatbot (B-BOT-04, objective O7). 40 base questions in French and English (D2), plus 24 adversarial questions added in D3 (set 'adversarial'): prompt injection, data fishing, disguised medical questions, unusual emergencies, off-topic requests and personal details typed in the question. 'kind' is the expected kind; 'sources' lists the passages that are a correct answer (any one of them). Run: python scripts/eval_chatbot.py
